scope: One client and one dedicated-server executable run q3, ql, rtcw-sp and rtcw-mp in turn, each against its own installation and a fresh home: every client reaches its stock map and writes an engine screenshot, every multiplayer server answers getstatus. No input, no gameplay.

runsUtc.basis: modification times of the probe's output files

client.platform: Windows 11 x64 host, Windows x86 build: meson/build/win32-dev, MSVC 19.44, debugoptimized, strict warnings, renderers glx/vk/rtx as modules; RTCW, WolfET and Elite Force development gates on

server.platform: Windows 11 x64 host, Windows x86 build: meson/build/win32-dev, MSVC 19.44, debugoptimized, strict warnings, renderers glx/vk/rtx as modules; RTCW, WolfET and Elite Force development gates on

environment: Windowed on unswitched private desktops (tests/windows_private_process.py), one fresh process and isolated fs_homepath per run under .tmp/probe-records/, sound and mouse/joystick input disabled, Steam integration and the WebUI off, loopback UDP only, console commands only. Retail installations were read, never written. GLx renderer, pure off, bots off.

q3.command: +set com_gameProfile q3 +set fs_basepath C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Quake 3 Arena +set fs_homepath .tmp\probe-records\release-profiles\q3-client +set fs_game  +set r_fullscreen 0 +set r_mode 3 +set in_mouse 0 +set in_joystick 0 +set in_nograb 1 +set s_initsound 0 +set com_steamIntegration 0 +set fs_skipWorkshop 1 +set cl_webuiEnable 0 +set cl_renderer glx +set logfile 2 +set net_port 0 +set com_introplayed 1 +set cl_allowDownload 0 +set bot_enable 0 +set sv_pure 0 +set con_notifytime 0 +set activeAction wait 200; screenshotPNG release-q3; wait 5; quit +set sv_master1  +set sv_master2  +set sv_master3  +set sv_master4  +set sv_master5  +devmap q3dm1
